summary: Single-engine American Champion crashed in heavy timber near Milner Pass/upper Forest Canyon; pilot J.M., 54, and his daughter T.M., 18, both of Wisconsin walked away with minor injuries, built shelter from debris and lit signal fires; located via CAP ELT signals, flown out by Grand Teton helicopter
notes: NPS morning report (reported 2010-07-12): crash Thursday; wings folded back, cockpit intact; FAA/NTSB investigating
